post.description: With batchId, 202 acknowledges durable receipt. Billing and daily statistics are applied atomically once per node and batch. Different records under the same ID return 409. Without batchId the existing non-deduplicated accounting path remains.

V2Node and V2Box scoped DDNS reporting. Bearer report key identifies one configured node. Neither the Cloudflare token nor the panel server_token is accepted. Each family must be public and allowed by the binding. Missing families retain their independent freshness timestamp; reports never reset provider backoff.

post.description: Optional non-billing target aggregates. Disabled or stale policy returns accepted=false. Retry the same immutable batch ID. Data expires from cache within one hour. Uncompressed JSON body limit: 262144 bytes. Quota: 30 requests/minute per authenticated node, independent of source IP. Each counter summed over all records in a batch must not exceed 1000000000000000; rejection writes no partial rows.

403.description: Credential is not authorized for this node identity.

get.description: Static Linux sh entry point using official pinned v1.0.2 installer. Installs missing dependencies before re-executing bash. Default mode accepts --api-host/--node-id/--deploy-token for noninteractive installation (grant stdin remains compatible), checks the returned identity, and refuses configured nodes. Legacy URL/grant stdin remains supported. --install forwards subsequent arguments to the official installer for manual installation or configuration-preserving upgrade.

post.description: Burn a 10-minute one-use grant and issue one scoped credential. New grants supersede old grants. Credential/administrator changes invalidate grants; issuance does not happen until redemption. Lost responses require a new grant. No query tokens.

apiKey.description: One-time secret. Never logged or listed.

singBox.description: Resolved native sing-box configuration from the V2Box-only routing catalog. Selected native rules are merged in selection order; legacy routes cannot be mixed with native rules.

trafficBatchDedup.description: When true, the panel supports durable deduplicated traffic batches. Missing means unsupported.

reportIntervalSeconds.description: Optional reporting cadence. Omitted on older panels means 60 seconds. Refresh policy independently at most every 60 seconds; leaseSeconds remains at most 120.
